name: ai-hover-tool
description: Hover over any keyword or identifier to get an AI-generated definition and an explanation of how it's used in the surrounding code, powered by Groq's free, ultra-fast LPU inference.

commands.title: AI Hover Tool: Set Groq API Key
AI Hover Tool: Clear Groq API Key
AI Hover Tool: Clear Explanation Cache

enumDescriptions: Fastest responses (~1000 tokens/sec on Groq). Good default for hover tooltips.
aiHoverTool.model.description: Groq model used to generate hover explanations.

aiHoverTool.contextLines.description: Number of lines of surrounding code (above and below the hovered word) sent as context.

aiHoverTool.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the generated explanation. Lower = faster and more concise.

aiHoverTool.minWordLength.description: Minimum identifier length to trigger an AI hover lookup.

aiHoverTool.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs where AI hovers are disabled.
